notes:
PlaneSite 2.0 — from mapping flight to spray drone in one job:
- Projects page: PlaneSite opens on your projects. Plan a mission starts a job before the flight: import the customer's boundary, reuse an earlier field, or find the spot (address, coordinates, Google Maps link or the map) and draw the field on a USDA satellite map.
- Send to Pilot 2: the mapping mission goes to the M4E controller's cloud library. Height in feet with a linked GSD, speed in mph, overlaps, edge buffer, real-time terrain follow and elevation optimization.
- After the flight, add the photos to the same job: the field stays in place on the new orthomosaic, ready to refine.
- Obstacles: mark trees, poles and buildings inside a field.
- Export boundaries for DJI Pilot 2, DJI Agras / SmartFarm, XAG, Ceres Applicator View and other software.
- XAG map tiles: the orthomosaic as sharper web-map tiles for XAG One, and Publish to GitHub (sign in with GitHub, choose the organisation, large maps go up in parts).
- Every export goes to the project's exports folder; PlaneSite's own files move into 'PlaneSite data' the first time a project is opened in 2.0.
- The window opens maximized.
Note: once a project has been opened in 2.0, PlaneSite 1.6 can't show its map, so update every computer that shares projects.
